crossRefs.note: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

parallels.note: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us…

translations.web: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
translations.bsb: How many are my iniquities and sins? Reveal to me my transgression and sin.
translations.kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
translations.asv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.
